detail.text:
Summary for the operator:

Reports Agent extracted noon report nr-0006 for MV VALDA CREST (SIM-0001). Voyage Agent found the Master's ETA Rotterdam of 2025-01-25 2100 UTC inconsistent — computed ETA is 1633 UTC, a 4.5-hour difference beyond the 2-hour tolerance — and no CP ETA notice is due. Performance Agent found VLSFO consumption (26 t) exactly at the warranted 26 t/day, within warranty, no action. Reports Agent flagged a position/distance inconsistency (straight-line 355.7 nm from the last noon position vs 297.6 nm run); the remarks about the engine stop do not explain it.

Two items need your decision before any message goes out: (1) ask the Master to check the position/distance run figures, and (2) ask the Master to confirm the ETA. I have placed a yes-or-no question on your desk covering both; please reply yes or no, and I will then draft the e-mail to the Master using only figures the colleagues reported.
